prompt: Year-over-year change in covid deaths by state, 2021 vs 2022

WITH yearly_deaths AS (
    SELECT 
        "Province_State",
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") AS year,
        SUM("daily_new_deaths") AS total_deaths
    FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a"
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") IN (2021, 2022)
    GROUP BY "Province_State", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date")
),
yoy_change AS (
    SELECT 
        d2021."Province_State",
        d2021.total_deaths AS deaths_2021,

            ELSE NULL
        END AS pct_change
    FROM yearly_deaths d2021
    LEFT JOIN yearly_deaths d2022 
        ON d2021."Province_State" = d2022."Province_State" 
        AND d2022.year = 2022
    WHERE d2021.year = 2021
)
SELECT 
    "Province_State",
    deaths_2021,
    deaths_2022,
    pct_change
FROM yoy_change
ORDER BY "Province_State"
